items.question: What is the H Company Agents API?
items.answer: The Agents API is H Company's API for operational computer-use agents. You configure, deploy, and monitor agents that run at production scale in the browser and on the desktop, with human-level accuracy. H Company handles agent orchestration, environments and the model, so you build agentic features into your product without the agent plumbing.

items.question: What can Agents API agents do?
items.answer: Agents API agents see the screen, locate UI elements, and move through interfaces the way a person would. They open pages, follow flows, and extract what you need from live web apps, and control desktop environments with clicks, typing, and full session replay. Showcase examples include QA testing a live URL, turning any web page into typed data, and completing a purchase flow on any site.

items.question: How much does the H Company Agents API cost?
items.answer: The Agents API starts free: up to 3 concurrent agents and about 60 sessions a month, with no credit card required. Builder costs $20 per month (up to 10 concurrent agents) and Startup $200 per month (up to 100 concurrent agents); the first $20 or $200 of usage is at model cost and top-ups are at model cost + 20%. Enterprise pricing is custom, with no concurrency cap.

items.question: Which model powers H Company agents?
items.answer: Agents API agents run on Holo4, H Company's own computer-use model family, on a model, inference, harness and RL stack that H Company owns end to end. It is not a prompt wrapped around a generalist model: purpose-built Holo models cost 40% less per run than a general-purpose LLM that does the same GUI task.

items.question: How do I connect the Agents API to my stack?
items.answer: The Agents API is available as an MCP server, a REST API, a CLI, and an n8n node. It connects to Claude, Hermes, Cursor, or your own stack with one API key.

items.question: Which environments do Agents API agents run in?
items.answer: Agents run in H Company's cloud browser and cloud desktop, or in your own browser and on your own desktop. The same agent can be tested across browser and desktop without standing up separate infrastructure for each: one harness handles the visual actions on every surface.

items.question: Can I see what an agent did?
items.answer: Yes. The H Platform console keeps full logs and a session replay for every agent action, so you see exactly where and why a run failed and keep control over sensitive tasks.

items.question: How does the Agents API protect my data?
items.answer: H Company is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified, with regional data residency and a zero retention mode. Credentials are kept in vaults and browser profiles, with 2FA support.

items.question: Where can I get help with the Agents API?
items.answer: Join the H developer Discord for questions, bugs, and feature requests, or write to support@hcompany.ai.
